reason: I'm not putting a bot into my staff group chats and signing it into my Google account just to sort receipts. I only look at the money when something feels off, and when it does I scroll the group myself.
objection: A bot I don't know reads every message in my work chats and gets into my Google Drive. Who's behind it, where does that data go, and what happens if it leaks?
would_change_my_mind: If it only got access to its own single sheet instead of my whole Google account, read only receipts I forward to it myself, and another café owner I know said they'd used it for months without trouble.
